200.description: Success – for GET /Group (search) the response is a FHIR Bundle of type searchset containing matching Group resources; for GET /Group/<id> (read) the response is the Group resource directly.

404.description: Not Found – the specified Group was not found.

406.description: Not Acceptable – Accept header does not include application/fhir+json.

500.description: Internal Server Error – payer service error.

504.description: Gateway Timeout – internal request timed out.
